translations.web: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
translations.bsb: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
translations.kjv: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
translations.asv: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
